What's inside

A README-first repository where the diagrams are the content: sequence diagrams, flowcharts, and the OAuth token-exchange flows I drew for the article on wiring OAuth into CKEditor real-time collaboration - all rendered natively by GitHub's Mermaid support, no image exports involved.
